# There is and there are

## What you will learn
There is introduces one thing or an uncountable amount; there are introduces several things. Use is there/are there for questions.

## Example in context
There is a cat under the table. There are two cats outside.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
Do not use there is with a plural count noun in standard school English.

## Practice and reflection
Complete: There ___ five books on the shelf.
**Model answer:** are

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.

## In simple words

**Remember this example:** There is a cat under the table. There are two cats outside.

**Be careful:** Do not use there is with a plural count noun in standard school English.
